description: Pass a task to another agent the user named, using the task's exact eight-character key and the agent id copied from get_agents. If the name matches no agent or several, ask the user. If the agent is not found, call get_agents again. Log a hand-off note with log_task_progress first: what is done, what is left and where your work is. Works when you hold the task or nobody does. Success means the task moved to that agent and its start email is queued, not that the agent has begun; your claim is released. Repeating the call for the same agent changes nothing.
name: assign_task
title: Assign task
